concept.title: Configure Contact Methods in AlarmService
concept.shortdesc: When OnCall contacts an on-call user, OnCall must reference the scheduled list and know the appropriate contact method. The contact methods are set in the AlarmService to route alarms to users by adding AlarmRecipients. Refer to for more details. Only specific AlarmRecipients can route alarms to users.

conbody.p:
To configure the AlarmRecipients in the AlarmService, drag the two recipients in the AlarmService folder which are shown in the below examples.
EmailRecipient available in the email palette. It sends an email to the user's own email address. Refer to for more details.
SmsRecipient: available in the sms palette. It sends a text message to the user's own phone number. Refer to for more details.

Even if AlarmRecipients have contact details like email addresses or phone numbers, OnCall notifications are sent to the user's own contact details rather than those listed in the AlarmRecipient. You can link multiple OnCallContacts to a single AlarmRecipient.
conbody.note: Unlike other AlarmRecipients, it is not necessary to link anything to their route Alarm actions. You may use an existing AlarmRecipient that is already receiving alarms routed from an AlarmClass, or you may add an unlinked AlarmRecipient that is only used by onCall. Both will work.
